Introduction and Scope

At Fibax Ayurveda, we value the trust you place in us when sharing your personal information. This Privacy Policy outlines how Fibax Pharma ("we", "our", "us", or "the Business") collects, uses, processes, stores, and safeguards personal data obtained from customers, visitors, and registered users ("you", "your", or "Data Principal") who access our e-commerce portal at https://fibaxpharma.com and associated digital touchpoints (the "Website").

This Policy applies to all interactions with our Website, including product exploration, customer account creation, mobile OTP verification, online ordering, courier delivery tracking, customer support inquiries, and wellness consultation requests.

Please read this Policy carefully. By accessing or using our Website, you acknowledge that your personal information will be handled strictly in accordance with this Privacy Policy, our Terms & Conditions, and applicable Indian data-protection statutes.

2

Identity of Fibax Ayurveda and Data Fiduciary

For the purposes of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act) and the Information Technology Act, 2000, the Data Fiduciary determining the purpose and means of personal data processing on this platform is:

Business Trading Name: Fibax Pharma

Brand Identity: Fibax Ayurveda

Constitution of Business: Sole Proprietorship

Legal Proprietor Name: [OWNER CONFIRMATION REQUIRED: Legal Name of Sole Proprietor]

3

Information We Collect

In strict adherence to the statutory principle of Data Minimisation, Fibax Ayurveda collects only the personal information reasonably necessary to provide authentic Ayurvedic formulations, fulfill online purchases, deliver consignments to your doorstep, communicate order statuses, and comply with Indian taxation and consumer protection laws.

We do not collect excessive, irrelevant, or intrusive personal information, and we do not monitor your offline activities.

4

Account Registration and OTP Verification Data

When you create a customer account or verify your identity during checkout, we collect:

  • Full Name: To personalize your account and label delivery consignments accurately;
  • Indian Mobile Number (10 digits): Serving as your primary account identifier and authentication credential;
  • Email Address: Optional or provided during checkout for transmitting digital tax invoices, order confirmations, and dispatch notifications;
  • One-Time Password (OTP): A temporary 4-digit code generated during authentication. OTPs are stored ephemerally in server memory with a 10-minute expiry and are automatically purged upon verification;
  • Password Hash (if password registered): If you set an account password, it is cryptographically salted and hashed using Node.js scrypt (64-byte key). Plain-text passwords are never stored or visible to our administrators;
  • Session Token: An encrypted 32-byte cryptographic token (cust_...) stored in your browser's local storage for a 30-day session lifetime.
5

Profile and Delivery Address Information

To deliver physical packages to your doorstep, we collect and store:

  • House / Flat / Street address and locality;
  • City, District, and State;
  • 6-digit Indian Postal PIN Code (used for courier serviceability validation);
  • Optional landmark details to facilitate delivery couriers;
  • Recipients' secondary contact phone numbers if specified for doorstep delivery.

You can review, update, or edit your saved delivery addresses at any time directly from the Profile → Saved Addresses dashboard in your customer account.

6

Order, Cart and Transaction Records

When you initiate a purchase on our Website, we record:

  • Unique Order Identification number (e.g., #FBX-100234);
  • Selected Ayurvedic formulations, pack sizes, and quantities ordered;
  • Transaction timestamps (order placement, dispatch, delivery, or cancellation date);
  • Total order pricing, itemized item subtotals, applied discount amounts, and shipping fees;
  • Promotional coupon codes applied during checkout;
  • Payment method selected (Prepaid Online or Cash on Delivery);
  • Active cart line items and wishlist items (stored locally on your device in browser localStorage).
7

All digital transactions are processed through Razorpay (Razorpay Software Private Limited), an RBI-authorized Payment Aggregator certified under the highest global security standard: PCI-DSS Level 1.

When you initiate a prepaid transaction, you enter your financial details exclusively inside Razorpay’s encrypted, secure modal. Fibax Ayurveda only receives and stores cryptographic audit tokens: razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id, and a cryptographic HMAC signature confirming successful settlement.

8

When an order is manifested for dispatch, we securely transmit only the necessary recipient delivery attributes to Delhivery via encrypted API:

  • Recipient Full Name;
  • Delivery Street Address, City, State, and 6-digit PIN Code;
  • Recipient Mobile Number (required for courier doorstep contact and delivery OTP);
  • Order Reference Number (e.g. FBX-100234);
  • Consignment parcel weight and broad commodity description ("Ayurvedic Formulations");
  • Payment Mode (Prepaid or COD) and the exact Cash on Delivery collectible amount, if applicable.

Delhivery processes this data strictly as a logistical data processor for the sole purpose of fulfillment and real-time tracking. We do NOT share customer email addresses, passwords, or transaction history with delivery couriers.

9

Customer Support and Communication Records

When you contact our customer support team via email (care@fibaxpharma.com), helpline (+91 8872544458), WhatsApp, or our online Contact Form, we collect:

  • Your name, phone number, and email address;
  • Your order reference number or product inquiry topic;
  • The contents of your inquiry, consultation query, or complaint;
  • Technical logs of the communication to verify resolution quality and customer satisfaction.
10

Our Website provides interactive features where you may volunteer information:

  • Product Reviews: Star ratings, review text, customer display name, and optional uploaded photos of received products;
  • Doctor Callback Requests: Name, phone number, and primary Ayurvedic health concern (e.g. Immunity, Joint Care, Digestion) submitted to schedule a personalized guidance call;
  • Formulation Suggestions: Classical herbs, blends, or health categories recommended by customers in the account dashboard.
11

Unlike many commercial portals, the Fibax Pharma backend does NOT plant intrusive third-party cross-site tracking cookies.

We use browser Local Storage and essential session technologies solely for functional website performance:

fibax_cart: Retains your active shopping bag items so you do not lose your selections when reloading pages.

fibax_wishlist: Stores your saved favorite Ayurvedic products locally on your device.

fibax_auth_token: Stores your encrypted session authorization token when you log in.

fibax_user: Caches your basic customer name and phone locally for fast UI rendering.

You can clear your local storage at any time through your browser settings. Doing so will simply empty your local cart and require you to sign in again via mobile OTP.

12

Web Analytics (Google Analytics & Microsoft Clarity)

To understand website performance, detect technical errors, and optimize page load speeds, our Website integrates two verified analytics services:

  • Google Analytics 4 (Google LLC): Embedded via Google Tag (Measurement ID: G-4DPG0SDPVQ). Measures aggregated page views, general geographic region, browser version, and traffic channels using standard analytical cookies (_ga). Google Analytics does not receive your name, address, or payment credentials.
  • Microsoft Clarity (Microsoft Corporation): Embedded via tracking ID otex02p22j. Measures aggregated UX interactions, click heatmaps, and scroll depth to identify broken links or sluggish UI components. Microsoft Clarity automatically masks sensitive personal inputs and passwords.
Verified Absence of Tracking Pixels: We do NOT run Meta (Facebook) advertising pixels, TikTok pixels, Google Ads remarketing pixels, or third-party ad network tracking scripts on this Website.
13

We process your personal information strictly for legitimate commercial and regulatory purposes:

  1. Order Processing & Fulfillment: Verifying order line items, packaging shipments, calculating accurate courier rates, and arranging delivery;
  2. Authentication & Security: Generating and validating SMS OTPs to prevent fraudulent or automated bot orders;
  3. Logistics Coordination: Transmitting dispatch details to Delhivery Express and updating live tracking statuses;
  4. Customer Support: Responding to inquiries, resolving delivery exceptions, processing return/refund requests, and conducting requested doctor callbacks;
  5. Statutory Tax Compliance: Maintaining financial accounts, generating GST-compliant tax invoices, and complying with Indian commercial audits;
  6. Platform Integrity: Protecting our web server against Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks, brute-force intrusions, and payment fraud.
14

Legal Basis and Consent for Data Processing

Under Section 4 and Section 6 of the DPDP Act, 2023 and the Indian Contract Act, 1872, our legal grounds for processing your personal information are:

  • Contractual Necessity: Processing required to accept your order, process payment, and deliver physical products you contracted to purchase;
  • Specific, Informed Consent: Provided when you enter your mobile number for OTP login, submit a contact message, or request an Ayurvedic doctor consultation;
  • Compliance with Legal Obligations: Mandatory retention of billing, tax invoice, and sales data under the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 and Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020;
  • Legitimate Uses: Prevention of fraud, security monitoring, and enforcement of our legal Terms.
15

Data Sharing with Authorized Third-Party Partners

Fibax Pharma does NOT sell, rent, trade, or monetize your personal data to data brokers, telemarketers, or unauthorized third parties.

We share data solely with verified operational processors bound by strict confidentiality and data protection obligations:

1. Courier & Logistics Partners (Delhivery Limited)

Receives name, shipping address, phone, and package details solely to execute physical delivery and live tracking.

2. Payment Gateway (Razorpay Software Private Limited)

Processes online UPI, card, and net banking payments via encrypted PCI-DSS channels.

3. Transactional Communication Services

Standard SMS gateways and SMTP email services used strictly to transmit order confirmations, dispatch receipts, and OTP verification codes.

4. Legal and Law Enforcement Authorities

Disclosed only when strictly required by a valid legal subpoena, court order, or regulatory directive under Indian law.

16

Data Storage, Hosting Infrastructure and Backups

Customer account records, orders, and customer inquiries are stored in secure server environments located in India.

  • Backend Architecture: Modern Node.js Express architecture with unified database persistence layers;
  • Hosting Provider: [OWNER CONFIRMATION REQUIRED: Primary Cloud Hosting Provider / Server Infrastructure Location];
  • Storage Redundancy: Server files maintain automated atomic backup copies (.bak files) to prevent data corruption during server updates;
  • Access Control: Administrative databases are protected by hashed credentials, session timeouts, and restricted administrative routes accessible only to authorized personnel.
17

Data Retention and Purpose Limitation Periods

We retain personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was gathered, or as mandated by statutory Indian laws:

  • Active Customer Accounts: Retained for the duration of your active account so you can access your order history, tracking records, and saved addresses;
  • Financial & Tax Invoices: Retained for a minimum of 8 (eight) financial years in compliance with the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 and Income Tax Act, 1961;
  • Order Fulfillment & Courier Logs: Retained for 180 days post-delivery to resolve courier claims, warranty inquiries, or customer support disputes;
  • OTP Verification Codes: Held in memory for a maximum of 10 minutes and purged immediately upon verification or expiry;
  • Customer Support Messages: Retained for up to 12 months to monitor service quality and resolve repeat inquiries.
18

Technical and Organizational Security Safeguards

We have implemented robust commercial security safeguards designed to protect personal data from accidental loss, unauthorized access, destruction, or disclosure:

256-Bit SSL Transport Encryption

All web traffic between your browser and our servers is encrypted using modern TLS/HTTPS protocols.

Scrypt Password & Token Hashing

Cryptographic hashing ensures passwords cannot be reverse-engineered even in the event of an infrastructure breach.

Rate-Limiting & Anti-Brute Force

API rate limiters automatically block excessive login attempts and bot attacks.

Sanitized Input Validation

All user inputs are stripped of malicious code, SQL injection, and Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vectors.

While we enforce strict commercial safeguards, please remember that no method of electronic internet transmission is 100% invulnerable. We encourage you to safeguard your mobile device and never share your OTPs with anyone.

19

Cross-Border and International Data Transfers

Fibax Ayurveda conducts its business within India, serving consumers across Indian states and union territories.

Customer databases, order records, and shipping addresses are stored within Indian jurisdictions. Certain global service providers (such as Google Analytics or Microsoft Clarity) may process aggregated, anonymized analytical telemetry through their globally distributed cloud networks in compliance with applicable cross-border data transfer regulations and standard contractual privacy clauses under the DPDP Act.

  • Right to Access Information: You have the right to obtain a summary of personal data being processed by us and the identities of data processors with whom such data has been shared;
  • Right to Correction & Updating: You have the right to request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal data;
  • Right to Erasure: You have the right to request deletion of your personal data when the purpose of collection has been served, subject to statutory tax and accounting retention requirements;
  • Right to Grievance Redressal: You have the right to readily available means of grievance redressal regarding any act or omission of the Data Fiduciary;
  • Right to Nominate: You have the right to nominate another individual who shall, in the event of death or incapacity, exercise your privacy rights.

  • Transactional vs. Promotional: We distinguish strictly between essential transactional communications (order receipts, Delhivery tracking links, OTPs) and promotional wellness newsletters;
  • Opt-In Clarity: We do not make consent for promotional advertising a compulsory precondition for placing a standard product order;
  • Opt-Out Mechanism: You may opt out of promotional emails by clicking the "Unsubscribe" link in any promotional message, or by sending an email with "UNSUBSCRIBE" to care@fibaxpharma.com. We will process your opt-out within 48 business hours.

Statutory Retention Notice: In compliance with the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 and Indian accounting standards, historical sales invoices and order tax entries must be retained for legal and tax audit periods and cannot be wiped immediately upon request.

23

Our Website is directed exclusively to adults aged 18 years and above. We do not knowingly solicit, collect, or process personal data from children under the age of 18 without verifiable parental or lawful guardian consent in accordance with Section 9 of the DPDP Act, 2023.

If we discover that personal information of a minor has been collected on our Website without verified parental consent, we will take immediate steps to delete such data from our servers. Parents or guardians who believe their child has provided personal information may contact us at care@fibaxpharma.com.

24

Our Website may occasionally contain links to external sites (such as scientific botanical studies, courier tracking portals, or social media pages).

Fibax Pharma has no control over and assumes no responsibility for the content, privacy policies, or practices of any third-party websites or services. We encourage you to read the privacy notices of any external site you visit.

Data Breach Notification and Incident Response

In the unlikely event of a security incident or personal data breach affecting our systems:

  • Notifications will describe the nature of the breach, affected data categories, and recommended protective steps for customers.

DPDP Act Compliance and Statutory Timeline

Statutory Phased Implementation Notice:

The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the DPDP Rules, 2025 operate under a phased commencement framework established by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India:
